title: ephemeral evacuation proxy and SLO-constraint warden (hotfix)
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Hotfix: Add ephemeral evacuation proxy to buffer egress during regional overloads; introduce SLO-constraint warden to enforce tenant soft-quotas and graceful deny windows. Improves stability during KV pressure and prevents circuit thrashing.

description: Summary: Hotfix to stabilize regional failovers under KV pressure by introducing an ephemeral evacuation proxy (lightweight egress buffer) and an SLO-constraint warden (tenant soft-quotas + grace windows). Motivation: an incident on 2026-01-08 produced a cascade: heavy KV eviction -> long tail latencies -> frequent circuit flips -> client thrash and regional failover. Root cause analysis indicated missing short-term egress buffering and a blind global circuit that allowed noisy tenants to force repeated reopens. This PR implements two complementary mitigations: 1) Ephemeral evacuation proxy sits in the outgoing path of regional edge nodes. It buffers a limited number of in-flight requests, applies backpressure to upstream routers, and exposes metrics for overflow/latency. The proxy favors low-latency passthrough but will queue requests for up to evac_proxy.max_buffer_ms before applying a soft deny. 2) SLO-constraint warden runs in control plane and monitors per-tenant SLO budget trajectories; when a tenant is trending to breach regional SLOs it enforces a configurable soft-deny window and a decaying penalty bucket. The warden intentionally prefers low-impact, reversible actions (soft-deny, slowed requeues) rather than hard preemption. Key design decisions: - Soft-deny semantics: requests are rejected with a structured response (429 + JSON body hinting retry_after) to enable SDKs to apply jittered backoff. - Grace window: tenants get a temporary soft-deny window with exponential decay to allow recovery. - Observability: exported metrics include evac_proxy.buffered_requests, evac_proxy.buffer_overflow_total, slo_warden.soft_denies_total, slo_warden.penalty_score_gauge. Traces include decision_context tags to audit why a tenant was wardened. - Configuration: defaults are conservative; operators can configure per-tenant windows, max_buffer_ms, drain_timeout, and thresholds. Checklist: - [x] Implement evacuation proxy and handler (pkg/proxy/evac_proxy.go) - [x] Implement SLO-constraint warden and basic heuristics (pkg/control/slo_warden.go) - [x] Add unit tests for core logic and race guards - [x] Add integration test that replays incident trace and verifies no circuit thrash - [x] Add canary helm values and docs/ops runbook - [x] Add metrics + dashboards skeleton and alert rule guidance - [x] Per-reviewer nits resolved and CI green Commits: feat(proxy): add ephemeral evacuation proxy component with async buffering and decaying backpressure; feat(slo): implement SLO-constraint warden; chore(config): add evacuation chart; test: add harness; fix(flaky): guard kv drain path Files changed (high-level): - pkg/proxy/evac_proxy.go: main proxy with ring buffer and drain semantics. (See comments explaining backpressure thresholds.) - pkg/proxy/evac_handler_test.go: unit tests for buffer overflow and graceful shutdown. - pkg/control/slo_warden.go: warden heuristics, penalty bucket, soft-deny API hook. - pkg/control/slo_warden_test.go: unit tests for penalty decay and concurrent updates. - cmd/agent/main.go: wiring flag to enable proxy and warden. - configs/evac-proxy.yaml: default runtime config. - helm/evac-proxy/values.yaml: canary defaults (smaller buffer, shorter grace). - docs/operations/evacuation-proxy.md: operational runbook and troubleshooting. - observability/metrics/evac_proxy.metrics.yaml: metric names and alert suggestions. Testing and CI: initial pipeline surfaced a lint failure and a flaky integration test. Fixed linter issues and added deterministic seeding to the integration harness. Rerun produced all-green: unit tests 98 passed, integration 12 passed, e2e canary verified with synthetic KV pressure (no circuit flips during 10m injection). Review thread highlights: - Anika requested an ops doc and extra metric; added. - Diego requested graceful shutdown and per-tenant config; implemented. - Samir found and helped triage a race on kv drain. Merge: Squash-merged to main by Anika Patel on 2026-01-28 after green CI. Rollout plan: - Canary rollout in eu-west-1 with helm/evac-proxy/values.yaml for 24h. - If stable, promote to regional release across all regions over 48h. Post-deploy monitoring: watch slo_warden.soft_denies_total, evac_proxy.buffer_overflow_total, per-tenant latency p95, and circuit flip rate (target: circuit flips down by >=80% vs incident baseline). Notes and followups: - ENG-2201: follow-up to add adaptive thresholds using ML-driven SLO forecast (tracked in Linear). - SUP-4122: customer-facing postmortem to include condensed description and mitigation steps. This PR is intentionally conservative — no hard preemption and no config-breaking defaults. It reduces immediate incident blast radius and gives operators visibility and levers to tune behavior.
